summary.text: Ken DeGraaf, a Republican, represents District 22 (El Paso County) in the Colorado House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: He has held the seat since 2023 and is a candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was born in Michigan and served in the U.S. Air Force, Air Force Reserve and Air National Guard from 1986 to 2017.

DeGraaf earned a degree in aerospace structures from the U.S. Air Force Academy in 1990 and a master's degree in structural dynamics from Columbia University in 1991, and has worked as a commercial aviator.
